prompt.character: Draw a full main illustration of "{{name}}". Follow the current profile, appearance, outfit and art style, and keep every locked feature in each image.
prompt.characterCanon: Draw "{{name}}" exactly as the final design: keep the hair, outfit and colors unchanged and only adjust the framing for this drawing.
prompt.part: Based on the current main illustration, draw a {{view}} design of "{{name}}". {{description}}
prompt.turnaround: Draw a turnaround of "{{name}}": front, side and back full-body views side by side in one image. Follow the current profile, appearance, outfit and art style, and keep every locked feature in each view.
prompt.turnaroundCanon: Draw a turnaround of "{{name}}" exactly as the final design: keep the hair, outfit and colors unchanged and only lay it out as front, side and back full-body views side by side.
prompt.turnaroundFromPortrait: Draw a turnaround of "{{name}}" based on the current main illustration: keep the design unchanged and only lay it out as front, side and back full-body views side by side.
prompt.redrawView: Redraw the {{view}} view of "{{name}}" from the front view: keep the design exactly and draw one full-body figure at the same height as the front. The previous one was wrong, so don't follow it.
prompt.front: Draw "{{name}}" from the front, full body: one figure facing forward in a neutral A-pose. Follow the current profile, appearance, outfit and art style, and keep every locked feature. The side and back will be drawn from this image later.
prompt.frontCanon: Draw "{{name}}" from the front exactly as the final design: keep the hair, outfit and colors unchanged and draw one full-body figure facing forward in an A-pose.
prompt.frontFromPortrait: Draw "{{name}}" from the front based on the current main illustration: keep the design and draw one full-body figure facing forward in an A-pose.
prompt.drawView: Draw the {{view}} view of "{{name}}" from the front view: keep the design exactly and draw one full-body figure at the same height as the front.
